About this design preview

The original cabinet arrangement and all 79 source faces are retained from your supplied SketchUp model. Beige glossy solid fronts, wood-grain open boxes and no handles. The identification colours are available under Reference colours.

Light yellow: oil pull-out. Mustard: rice basket. Green: S-corner basket. Dark red: plain tandem drawers. Pink: pan pull-out. Brown: glass shutters. The open section beside the rice basket contains two wicker baskets without shutters. Hardware is a design visualization.
